records.c: Advance the active slot's actor type, choose a facing frame by comparing its X coordinate with Arthur and initialize its frame delay. Shift it four pixels up and occasionally select type $13.
On a nonzero scroll phase, advance the current sprite frame. Reaching frame $37 moves the actor down four pixels and switches it to actor type four.
Every eighth value of $BC advance the shape by two. At shape $0E or later, clear the flags and advance the actor type before the common positioning path.
On scroll phase three, move the shape backward by two. Below shape four, deactivate the slot and its linked slot if present, then decrement the optional actor count.
Age the frame delay or jump to the transition for a screen-edge position. Depending on pose flags, move down then sample terrain through $3D15 and $3C29.
First 256 bytes copied to $C400 by $53B4. These are title-screen character codes.
Next 256 bytes copy to $C500 through $53BA. The tail is also the source region of the title logo copy.
$53C5 reads 200 entries beginning here. It sets bit 7 before writing them from $C028 through $C0EF.
At column $4B, call $4873 when both flag tests permit it. At coarse scroll value $08, run $2F17 and reinitialize scrolling through $2E4D for selector $01.
